messages:
Jess (Sales): FYI ACME POC stuck on embeddings/rerank. They keep hitting a dims mismatch and occasional 429s. Can we swarm?
Aisha (ACME): repro steps in thread. We push candidate embeddings to /v1/embeddings/rerank and get back 400: \"dims mismatch (expected 1536, got 1024)\". Also seeing intermittent 429s when batching candidates.
Sam (Support): thanks — can you paste a minimal request you used and the model names?
Aisha (ACME): here's a trimmed payload we send (we removed the long vectors):
```json
POST /v1/embeddings/re-rank
{
  "query_embedding": [0.012, 0.23, ...],    // length 1536
  "candidate_embeddings": [
    [0.003, 0.45, ...],  // length 1024 in our client
    [0.11, 0.22, ...]
  ],
  "model": "acme-local-embed-compact-v1",
  "top_k": 10
}
```
Error log: `400 Bad Request - dims mismatch (expected=1536, actual=1024) at embeddings/verify.go:87`
Tara (Eng-ML): ok that explains it — the reranker service expects embeddings produced by our canonical embed model family (redwood-embed-large-v2) which uses 1536 dims. Your client is using a compact ACME model that emits 1024 dims. Rerank scoring is dimension-aware and will reject mismatched vectors.
Sam (Support): are there any supported on-the-fly projection options? Can we auto-project 1024 -> 1536?
Tara (Eng-ML): we have a server-side thin projector available (encoder: \"projector-v1\") but it's not enabled by default for POCs due to cost/quality drift. Short-term options:
- Swap ACME client to redwood-embed-large-v2 (recommended)
- Run a reprojection using our projector: POST /v1/embeddings/project with \"from_dim\" and \"to_dim\" (adds ~50ms/vector)
- As temporary hack, zero-pad/truncate vectors client-side (NOT recommended; changes geometry)
Sam (Support): noted. What about the 429s during batches?
Tara (Eng-ML): batching constraints: per-request candidate limit is 512 vectors; recommended batch_size is 128 to avoid memory spikes. There's also a per-minute vector rate limit for POC accounts (X-RateLimit-Vector-Remaining header). If they send large batches concurrently it will surface as 429.
Aisha (ACME): we were sending 1k candidates in one call to speed things up. Our client also serializes embeddings as base64 strings (we thought that reduced payload).
Sam (Support): please switch to JSON arrays of floats (not base64). The reranker expects numeric arrays. If you're base64-encoding, server can't validate dims until decode and we sometimes hit a payload parsing edge causing 400s.
Aisha (ACME): thanks — switching to arrays now. If we move to redwood-embed-large-v2, is there a sample cURL? Also, any pricing impact?
Sam (Support): cURL sample: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/re-rank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\n    "model": "redwood-embed-large-v2",\n    "query_embedding": [0.012, 0.23, ...],\n    "candidate_embeddings": [[0.003, 0.45, ...],[...]],\n    "top_k": 10\n  }'
```
JS fetch snippet: 
```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/re-rank', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-embed-large-v2', query_embedding, candidate_embeddings, top_k: 10 })
});
```
Tara (Eng-ML): performance notes: redwood-embed-large-v2 is 1536d, faster to rerank because it avoids projector latency. If they must keep 1024d embeddings, projector-v1 works but expect a ~15-50% throughput drop and small accuracy variance.
Jess (Sales): on pricing — embeddings billed per vector unit. For the POC we can apply a one-off credit, and if they switch model we can estimate cost delta. I can send an email estimate.
Aisha (ACME): after switching to JSON arrays and using 2 smaller batch calls (256 each) we still saw a couple 429s. Bot headers?:
deploy-bot: rate-limit response headers: X-RateLimit-Limit: 2000 vectors/min, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, Retry-After: 30
Sam (Support): that indicates burst exceeded. Please serialize calls with exponential backoff. We can also temporarily raise the POC rate limit if needed — I can request it if you send the account id.
Aisha (ACME): account id sent to Sam in DM. Switching model now and will re-run.
Mike (CSE): I'll coordinate a short huddle at 10:30 to watch the repro live and answer the pricing questions. Jess, Tara — can you join?
Tara (Eng-ML): I can join and bring a quick diagnostic script to verify dims and batch sizes.
Jess (Sales): I'll be there. I can also confirm credit allocation.
Aisha (ACME): great — thank you team. If this swap fixes it we'll proceed to integrate. I'll post back results here.
Sam (Support): follow-ups: I'll open a ticket to enable projector-v1 for POC-ACME (if they ask) and add a small guide about batching limits to our POC runbook.
Tara (Eng-ML): also filing a short infra action: add clearer error message for base64-encoded embedding payloads (GH #link-to-issue).
Aisha (ACME): switching models now — will report in ~20m. Thanks all :rocket:
